resolved_findings: Coordinator authority moved to refs/ask/accepted-tests/<id>; source commits cannot replace accepted obligations.
Task suites filter exact accepted case IDs; unfinished cases from another task do not block task completion.
AST inventory detects mapped behavior changes and tests outside test_ filenames; regression labels cannot waive changed behavior.
Reviewed typed exemptions only cover nonbehavioral changes with unchanged assertions.
Persisted evidence mutations exercise actual identity/outcome/log validation.
Static pass reloads individual check identities/outcomes/logs; no bare pass receipt.
Explicit capability version, successful FF integration, unsupported final-green exit statuses covered.
Own dynamic subtest removed; invalid historical attempts retained but cannot supply TDD evidence.
